info.title: Sheetbase external API
info.description:
Sheetbase external API v0.1 — one surface, two credential kinds.

Authenticate with `POST /api/token`, then call `/api/db/*` with the returned JWT as `Authorization: Bearer`. Both kinds share the `sb_<prefix>_<secret>` credential format and exchange into short-lived bearer JWTs (default TTL 300s).

- Service credentials (owner-minted in Administration) act as the **workspace service identity**: the JWT carries `role: 'api_client'` with no user id, and writes attribute to `credential_id`.
- Personal API tokens (member-minted in Settings) act as their **creating member**: the JWT carries `role: 'authenticated'` with the member's real `sub`, so member permissions and row-level security further constrain every request — a viewer's token is read-only. Removing or suspending the creating member makes the token unusable at exchange and at use time.

Both kinds are constrained by the same canonical scopes and the same fail-closed external allowlist. Neither creates a browser or human session: personal-token JWTs carry no `session_id` claim, so human attestation stays unavailable to external credentials.

Only operations an external credential can complete are listed. Unknown paths fail closed.

Errors: `POST /api/token` returns `{ error: { code, message } }`. `/api/db/*` returns `{ error: { category, message, request_id? } }`. Do not expect `code` on the data path.

Human-session-only (not callable with an API key): `submit_record_revision`, `run_revision_checks`, `sign_revision`, `create_amendment` and other review-transition writers.
`reviews:write` is mintable but does not open submit, sign, or amend.
`reviews:read` opens `preview_submission_digest` only.

Schema-authoring RPCs, file RPCs, and scientific-table REST are not part of this API.
`folders` and `record_field_definitions` are GET-only for external credentials (`api_client` has SELECT only). Folder writes and model-field authoring stay on the session path.
DELETE on `projects` is not granted to `api_client`.

Narrative contract: `docs/api/public-api-contract.md`. How to call this spec: `docs/api/openapi/README.md`. Credential mechanics: `docs/api/external-api.md`.

post.summary: Exchange a credential for a short-lived JWT
post.description: Unauthenticated. Accepts both workspace service credentials and personal API tokens — the same `sb_<prefix>_<secret>` format; the kind is determined by the credential row, not the request. Body `{ credential, scopes }` → `{ token }`. Failures use `TokenError` (`error.code`), never `error.category`.

get.description:
GET `agent_action_policies` through PostgREST.

Pagination: `limit` and `offset` query parameters.

Sort: `order=column.asc` or `column.desc`; repeat `order` for multiple columns.

Filters: `{column}={operator}.{value}` where operator is one of `eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, in, is, cs, cd, ov, fts, plfts, phfts, wfts, not`. Examples: `id=eq.<uuid>`, `kind=eq.experiment`, `status=in.(draft,in-progress)`.

Logic: `and=(status.eq.draft,kind.eq.experiment)` and `or=(...)`.

Count: send header `Prefer: count=exact` (optionally with `Range: 0-0` or `limit=0`) and read the total from `Content-Range`.

Column selection: `select=id,title`.

200.description: JSON array of `agent_action_policies` rows. With `Prefer: count=exact`, `Content-Range` is `start-end/total` (e.g. `0-24/123`).

Content-Range.description: Present when Prefer: count=* is honoured. Total is the number after the slash.

PipelineRunLogsRow.description: `api.pipeline_run_logs` row (snake_case). Ordered log of a run. A Python step’s entry carries what it printed (`detail.logs`), the environment it ran in (`detail.environment`) and, on failure, the line it failed on (`detail.line`). Logs can contain input values.

PipelineRunOutputsRow.description: `api.pipeline_run_outputs` row (snake_case). The Dataset Version a successful run wrote.

ExperimentPartsRow.description: `api.experiment_parts` row (snake_case). A part of an experiment that runs over several days: its own page of the notebook, on a day counted from the start of the experiment. Parts run in `position` order. A part is done when all its steps are, or when it was marked done by hand.

ReagentOrdersRow.description: `api.reagent_orders` row (snake_case). A reagent order: requested from a material that is running low, placed with the supplier, then received as a new lot. `status` is requested, ordered, received or cancelled.

RecurringSchedulesRow.description: `api.recurring_schedules` row (snake_case). A recurring experiment or booking. `kind` is `booking` or `experiment`; `status` is active, paused or ended.

RecurringOccurrencesRow.description: `api.recurring_occurrences` row (snake_case). One planned run of a recurring schedule and what became of it (`outcome`).

InstrumentServiceLogRow.description: `api.instrument_service_log` row (snake_case). A service, repair, calibration or other visit logged against an instrument.

ExperimentSeriesRow.description: `api.experiment_series` row (snake_case). An experiment that heads a series: it groups other experiments that run as separate pieces of one piece of work.

ExperimentSeriesMembersRow.description: `api.experiment_series_members` row (snake_case). An experiment in a series, with where it sits and the day it is planned. An experiment is in one series at most.

StepTimersRow.description: `api.step_timers` row (snake_case). A timer started on a protocol step. Personal tokens only: you see your own timers.

MaterialSafetyRow.description: `api.material_safety` row (snake_case). Chemical safety information for a material: hazard pictograms, signal word, hazard statements and the safety data sheet file.

MaterialIngredientsRow.description: `api.material_ingredients` row (snake_case). What went into a prepared solution: one row per ingredient lot, with quantity and unit.

StocktakesRow.description: `api.stocktakes` row (snake_case). A stocktake of a freezer, shelf or box. `status` is in_progress, completed or cancelled.

StocktakeItemsRow.description: `api.stocktake_items` row (snake_case). One item expected in or found during a stocktake, with where it should be, where it was found and how a mismatch was resolved.

InstrumentFeedsRow.description: `api.instrument_feeds` row (snake_case). A live measurement series on an instrument (temperature, pressure and so on), with its alert limits and last value.

InstrumentReadingsRow.description: `api.instrument_readings` row (snake_case). One reading in an instrument feed. Large; filter by `feed_id` and `taken_at`, or use `list_instrument_feed_series` for charts.

SampleWorkflowsRow.description: `api.sample_workflows` row (snake_case). A sample workflow: the stages a sample moves through. `status` is draft, active or archived.

SampleWorkflowStagesRow.description: `api.sample_workflow_stages` row (snake_case). A stage in a sample workflow, with its turnaround time, required fields and actions.

SampleWorkflowTransitionsRow.description: `api.sample_workflow_transitions` row (snake_case). Which stage a sample may move to from another stage.

SampleWorkflowRunsRow.description: `api.sample_workflow_runs` row (snake_case). A sample's journey through a workflow: its current stage, when it entered and when it is due.

SampleWorkflowEventsRow.description: `api.sample_workflow_events` row (snake_case). The history of moves a sample made through a workflow.

RequestFormsRow.description: `api.request_forms` row (snake_case). Which record models accept requests, their intro text and who handles them.

ShipmentsRow.description: `api.shipments` row (snake_case). A sample shipment in or out. `direction` is inbound or outbound; `status` is draft, in_transit, received or cancelled.

ShipmentItemsRow.description: `api.shipment_items` row (snake_case). An item on a shipment, with whether it arrived and in what condition.

InstrumentBookingRulesRow.description: `api.instrument_booking_rules` row (snake_case). Booking limits on an instrument: longest booking and how far ahead people may book.

InstrumentRequiredTrainingRow.description: `api.instrument_required_training` row (snake_case). Training protocols a person must hold before booking an instrument.

FieldSpecLimitsRow.description: `api.field_spec_limits` row (snake_case). Specification and alert limits for a numeric field on a record kind.

ModelIncidentLogsRow.description: `api.model_incident_logs` row (snake_case). Record models that are used as incident logs.

LegalHoldsRow.description: `api.legal_holds` row (snake_case). A legal hold keeping records from deletion or archiving until it is released.

LegalHoldRecordsRow.description: `api.legal_hold_records` row (snake_case). A record placed on a legal hold.

RetentionRulesRow.description: `api.retention_rules` row (snake_case). How many months each kind of record is kept before it comes up for archiving.

RequestDetailsRow.description: `api.request_details` row (snake_case). What was asked and how it was decided, for each request record.

RecordSpecResultsRow.description: `api.record_spec_results` row (snake_case). Each record's value for a field with result limits, and whether it is within spec, in the alert band or out. Personal tokens only.

MyWorkItemsRow.description: `api.my_work_items` row (snake_case). What is waiting on the person: reviews, tasks, assigned records and so on. Personal tokens only.

InboxWorkItemsRow.description: `api.inbox_work_items` row (snake_case). The person's Inbox items with tab and type. Personal tokens only.

ProjectFollowsRow.description: `api.project_follows` row (snake_case). Projects a person follows. Personal tokens only: you see your own follows.

PlateRunsRow.description: `api.plate_runs` row (snake_case). Plate runs: one plate read on an instrument, with its layout, readout, analysis settings and the last analysis (normalised values, Z-prime, hits and curves).

PlateWorklistsRow.description: `api.plate_worklists` row (snake_case). Liquid handler worklists: the transfers from a source plate to a destination plate, and what the robot log said was moved.

AgentActionRequestsRow.description: `api.agent_action_requests` row (snake_case). An action an agent asked to take. `level` is what the workspace had set for it (auto, ask or never); `status` is pending (waiting for a person), approved, rejected, succeeded, failed or refused. A token sees only its own requests.

LabWatchersRow.description: `api.lab_watchers` row (snake_case). A scheduled review the lab turned on. `kind` is stock_expiring, stock_low, work_overdue, data_missing or results_off; `schedule` is hourly, daily or weekly.

PipelineReproductionsRow.description: `api.pipeline_reproductions` row (snake_case). A finished pipeline run run again from its pinned version, parameters and inputs, and compared with the original. `status` is matches, differs or failed; `compared` says what it was compared against (the output dataset version, the stored preview, or the content digest); `summary` has the counts and `changes` the first differences.

LineageTargetsRow.description: `api.lineage_targets` row (snake_case). A place lineage events (OpenLineage) are sent: its address, namespace, the name of the header it signs with (the value is never shown) and whether it is switched on. Only people who manage integrations see these.

LabWatcherFindingsRow.description: `api.lab_watcher_findings` row (snake_case). Something a watcher found, with the record it is about and, where one makes sense, a suggested action. `status` is open, snoozed, dismissed or resolved (no longer true).

InstrumentRunDocumentsRow.description: `api.instrument_run_documents` row (snake_case). Instrument files converted to the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM): one vendor-neutral document per instrument run, with the converter, its version and the image that ran it.

QcSeriesRow.description: `api.qc_series` row (snake_case). Quality control series: a value tracked across runs (a plate assay metric, or any value sent in), with its limits, the Westgard rules and whether it is in control.

QcPointsRow.description: `api.qc_points` row (snake_case). Quality control points: each value of a series with its distance from the mean in SD, the Westgard rules it broke and whether someone has acknowledged it.

LineageDeliveriesRow.description: `api.lineage_deliveries` row (snake_case). Each lineage event waiting to go to, or sent to, an endpoint. `status` is pending, delivered or failed; a failed one can be tried again with `retry_lineage_deliveries`.
